beedie-beedie:lever:97309cd9-d9c0-481c-9.title: Senior Development Manager
beedie-beedie:lever:97309cd9-d9c0-481c-9.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. Since 1954, Beedie has combined innovation and craftsmanship to bring new possibilities to life. Today, we are one of Canada’s largest industrial and residential developers, having completed more than 35 million square feet of new development across BC, Alberta, southern Ontario, and Las Vegas, Nevada. With multiple industrial projects currently under construction and 9 projects totaling over 1.5M SF currently in development across the GTA, Beedie is looking for talented individuals to join our growing Ontario team as we continue to be built for good. Responsible for managing acquisition opportunities, the approval process, and contributing to the construction and eventual lease or sale of industrial projects in Ontario from conception through stabilization.. With the support of the BC & Alberta Development Team, this individual will guide the due diligence review of land and building acquisitions, manage and edit development proformas, review of legal contracts, manage and engage consultants and preparation, submission and negotiation for site plan approval, draft plan approval and permitting.
responsibilities: Manage the land acquisitions process by reviewing zoning bylaws, restrictive covenants, design guidelines and preliminary design drawings.
Visit prospective land opportunities to assess existing conditions, prepare a comprehensive condition assessment report, and identify any site‐specific extraordinary costs.
Review due diligence packages including geotechnical and environmental reports and obtain site preparation budgets.
Communicate with brokerage community on a regular basis to answer questions regarding acquisitions and proposed developments.
Meet with potential clients regarding build‐to‐suit purchases, leases and condo purchases.
Lead the consultant team with submission and rezoning applications, land subdivision and development permits and coordinate with municipal planning and building departments.
Expedite the resolution of all site plan approval or draft plan approval issues which arise to maintain project schedules and the level of quality of each project.
Participate in the RFP process by reviewing proposals and reviewing pre‐construction building specifications.
Lead site plan, draft plan, and building permit approvals.
Work with development team to generate building layouts for built‐to‐suit and speculative developments.
Participate in design meetings to analyze plans and specifications for coordination, constructability, value engineering, and completeness.
Establish and maintain relationships with relevant consultants.
Assist asset management team when required.
Assist the development team on scope and process questions throughout involvement of contractor.
Work closely with development, construction, sales, investment, asset management and property management teams to facilitate successful projects..
Establish key relationships with city staff in relevant jurisdictions.
Manage development proformas as a tool to schedule, consolidate budgets, present to senior leadership and assist in making business decisions.
Oversee and manage project budget approvals, budget management, and project reporting to ownership.
qualifications: Experience as a development manager in land and building development cycles.
Experience with reviewing proformas for purchasing, selling and leasing commercial properties.
Experience in working with municipal departments for rezoning, draft plans, site plans and building permit applications.
Strong understanding of legal contracts and title documents.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience as Development Manager.
Knowledge of the SPA, Draft Plan and BP process in a variety of municipalities and other city approvals.
Experience with land due diligence review, and managing tasks on multiple, concurrent projects.
Post‐secondary education in a related discipline.
Excellent communication skills, combined with proven presentation experience within a senior level management group.
A track record of establishing highly functional relationships with diverse personalities both within and outside the company.
Proficient in Excel, Word and Outlook as well as preferred knowledge of scheduling software.
Good knowledge of the Ontario building code.
Ability to evaluate multiple development paths (zoning strategy, phasing, servicing approach, tenant requirements) and select the option that optimizes risk-adjusted returns.
Ability to break complex, ambiguous development problems into manageable components
Asks questions that expose assumptions in consultant work, municipal feedback, and internal estimates.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c55fdf8f-bb7d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Romanian Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Czechia. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology. You will contribute authentic, high-quality Romanian voice data used to improve the clarity, naturalness, and expressiveness of AI-generated speech. The work combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic feedback, and AI training activities. You will record scripted content while assessing AI outputs for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional accuracy. Your expertise will help refine voice models and evaluation standards for applications spanning accessibility, education, entertainment, and more. The project offers a flexible remote environment suited to experienced contractors with a professional recording setup. It is an opportunity to apply your voice expertise to emerging AI technologies while directly influencing how machines communicate in Romanian. Record scripted material in Romanian with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, consistent pacing, and appropriate emotional expression. Produce high-quality voice recordings suitable for AI training and speech-model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, and expressiveness. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated outputs and provide clear, actionable feedback. Assess regional and linguistic variations in Romanian to help improve the authenticity and robustness of voice models. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, annotation practices, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting expertise to distinguish natural human speech from awkward, inaccurate, or unnatural AI-generated responses. Maintain consistent recording quality and follow technical, linguistic, and project-specific guidelines throughout assignments. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Romanian voice acting, dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Romanian language skills with excellent pronunciation and linguistic accuracy. Strong vocal control, including the ability to adjust tone, pacing, emphasis, emotion, and delivery according to different scripts and contexts. Excellent listening and evaluation skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, fluency, and naturalness issues. Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to follow detailed project guidelines. Experience with linguistic annotation, voice coaching, AI training, speech evaluation, or similar work is a plus. Access to a reliable computer, stable internet connection, high-quality microphone, and quiet recording environment. Ability to work independently and consistently as a remote freelance contractor. Curiosity about AI and an interest in contributing professional expertise to emerging speech technologies. Benefits Freelance contract with fully remote work. Flexible project-based working environment. Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of AI speech technology. Pay ranging from US$6 to US$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to apply professional Romanian voice expertise to large-scale AI training projects. Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools, speech technologies, and evaluation methodologies. Our partner is looking for a Test Manager based in Switzerland. This is a senior testing leadership opportunity within a fast-growing, international digital environment spanning insurance, e-commerce, and device protection. You will lead testing activities across a major technical delivery programme involving multiple projects, teams, and external partners. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on QA leadership, giving you significant influence over quality standards and delivery outcomes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f30a71b0-928a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Patient Advocate based in India. This is a customer-focused role supporting patients navigating the U.S. healthcare billing and insurance landscape. You will act as a key liaison between patients, healthcare providers, insurance payers, and Revenue Cycle Management teams. The role combines patient advocacy, medical billing support, claims research, and issue resolution. You will help patients understand benefits, deductibles, co-pays, balances, and payment responsibilities with empathy and clarity. Success requires strong knowledge of U.S. healthcare workflows and excellent professional English communication skills. You will work remotely within a collaborative, process-driven environment, with a strong focus on service quality, compliance, and accuracy. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on patient experience while contributing to efficient healthcare revenue cycle operations. Manage inbound and outbound communications with patients regarding medical bills, insurance claims, account balances, payments, reimbursements, and related inquiries. Explain insurance benefits, deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance, and out-of-pocket responsibilities in a clear, professional, and empathetic manner. Research and resolve billing and balance concerns by reviewing account notes, claim status, payment postings, and payer communications. Support claim follow-up, appeals, reconsiderations, and patient correspondence while identifying barriers to reimbursement. Collaborate with Accounts Receivable, Billing, Coding, Credentialing, and Account Management teams to resolve complex patient and payer issues. Accurately document patient interactions, account activity, follow-ups, and resolutions in designated systems while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Monitor assigned patient communication channels, respond within established SLAs, and complete follow-up, printing, and mailing activities accurately and on time. Participate in team meetings, quality reviews, training, and continuous improvement initiatives, identifying recurring patient issues and opportunities to improve processes. Maintain compliance with HIPAA, U.S. healthcare regulations, payer requirements, privacy standards, and internal policies. Support performance objectives related to productivity, response times, issue resolution, documentation accuracy, patient satisfaction, and overall revenue cycle effectiveness. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in U.S. healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical billing, accounts receivable, patient services, healthcare operations, or a related field. Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience. Experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare providers, physician groups, hospitals, healthcare outsourcing organizations, or offshore delivery operations is preferred. Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare revenue cycle workflows, including eligibility and benefits verification, medical billing, claims, payment posting, accounts receivable, denials, appeals, collections, and patient financial responsibility. Working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans. Familiarity with healthcare practice management systems, EMR/EHR platforms, and RCM technologies. Knowledge of medical terminology and familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS concepts is an advantage. Experience with denial management, payer follow-up, appeals, and reimbursement processes is preferred. Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S. patients.
